📷 Barcode scanner

Check whether you own a title, or scan a new purchase to add it. Scan its retail EAN/UPC barcode. ISBN barcodes are also accepted.

🖼 Find missing artwork

Search OMDb and TMDB poster listings for one film or a selection. Exact title matches are saved automatically; uncertain matches go to the review queue. Your own cover photos are never replaced.

Select individual films below, or scan a group.

✨ Smart Metadata

Automatically fills missing film details from OMDb and, optionally, TMDB. Only strong title-and-year matches are saved; uncertain results wait for your review. Batch checks fill blanks only. Single-film rescans can replace existing details after you review and confirm. Internet and API keys required.

One movie — rescan & replace

Search for a film in your collection. Choose the correct match and review its new information before replacing anything. Formats, personal notes, favourites and your own photos are protected.

Select a movie to edit its saved title.

Searches multiple possible matches. Select a poster/result to load full metadata, then choose whether to replace existing details. You can separately save the catalogue title above, or choose to use a matched title during the metadata review.

Select a title to begin.

Batch metadata & API settings

Fill missing metadata in batches. Existing values are retained.

Ready. Your existing film information will be kept.

Other metadata and artwork tools

Movie metadata assistant

Searches Apple UK/US, then Wikipedia when Apple returns no films. Possible matches and short Wikipedia introductions are suggested for your review. Descriptions may contain spoilers; check before applying. Some titles will not be found. Your original details and favourites are kept. Check suggestions before applying.

Add item

Scan a barcode or type the title and details below.

Change artwork image links

Paste a direct HTTPS image address. A preview appears above; long URLs stay inside these fields.

📷 My DVD / Blu-ray photographs

Photograph the exact front and back covers of your copy. Images are compressed and saved separately on this device.

Select photo area

Drag across the photograph to select an area. Use Crop photo to keep it, or Read selected text to extract only that section.

Text recognition requires internet access for the OCR library. Always check the extracted wording before saving.
